title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Free, under-21-safe art activities at FIU’s Patricia & Phillip Frost Art Museum.

cards.title: Browse the Frost Art Museum
cards.subtitle: Modesto A. Maidique Campus, 10975 SW 17th St
cards.notes: Plan a daytime gallery visit with friends, then take time with the exhibitions at your own pace. Check current museum hours before heading over.
cards.short_summary: Free public access to FIU’s on-campus art museum.
cards.evidence_claim: Frost Art Museum states that admission is always free and open to the public during normal museum hours.
cards.source_title: Visitor Information | Patricia & Phillip Frost Art Museum
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday through Sunday, 11 a.m.–5 p.m.; closed Mondays and most legal and university holidays. Admission is free.

cards.title: Walk the Sculpture Park
cards.subtitle: Patricia & Phillip Frost Art Museum, MMC
cards.notes: Make this an easy outdoor art walk: follow the works around the museum grounds, pause for photos from public paths, and respect the installations.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor collection stop beside the Frost Art Museum.
cards.evidence_claim: Frost Art Museum offers tours of its outdoor Sculpture Park, and the museum states its programs are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Tours | Patricia & Phillip Frost Art Museum
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access is subject to campus conditions; no admission or purchase is required for the museum’s free public programming.

cards.title: Join a Tertulia Nights conversation
cards.subtitle: Patricia & Phillip Frost Art Museum, MMC
cards.notes: RSVP for this second-Thursday program, arrive ready to listen and discuss, and use the museum setting as a low-pressure cultural night out.
cards.short_summary: A monthly after-hours exchange with artists, scholars, and changemakers.
cards.evidence_claim: Frost Art Museum describes Tertulia Nights as a second-Thursday monthly program that is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Community Programs | Patricia & Phillip Frost Art Museum
cards.access_notes: Recommended for ages 18 and older; RSVP through the museum’s current listing. The museum states the event is free and open to the public.

cards.title: See art at Frost After Dark
cards.subtitle: Patricia & Phillip Frost Art Museum, MMC
cards.notes: Choose a first Wednesday, reserve if requested, and use the extended evening opening to explore galleries with friends at a calmer pace.
cards.short_summary: A monthly evening opportunity to visit Frost’s galleries.
cards.evidence_claim: Frost Art Museum says Frost After Dark occurs on the first Wednesday each month and that admission is free.
cards.source_title: Community Programs | Patricia & Phillip Frost Art Museum
cards.access_notes: Recommended for ages 18 and older; check the next event listing for details. Admission is free, while refreshments are optional.

cards.title: Make art at a Frost Family Day
cards.subtitle: Patricia & Phillip Frost Art Museum, MMC
cards.notes: Bring younger siblings or family members, join the hands-on activities, and check the museum calendar for the next spring or fall date.
cards.short_summary: Seasonal hands-on art activities connected to museum exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: Frost Art Museum says Family Days take place every spring and fall and include hands-on art activities; museum programs are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Community Programs | Patricia & Phillip Frost Art Museum
cards.access_notes: All ages are welcome, though programming is geared to pre-K through middle-school ages. Check the museum calendar for the next date; no admission is required.

cards.title: Sketch during Drawing You In
cards.subtitle: Patricia & Phillip Frost Art Museum, MMC
cards.notes: Reserve a spot for the monthly drawing session, work through the gallery prompts, and bring a friend who wants a guided creative break.
cards.short_summary: A monthly drawing workshop paired with an exhibition tour.
cards.evidence_claim: Frost Art Museum describes Drawing You In as a monthly drawing session and exhibition tour, with all materials provided.
cards.source_title: Community Programs | Patricia & Phillip Frost Art Museum
cards.access_notes: Recommended for ages 14 and older; reserve through the museum’s current listing. Materials are provided and museum admission is always free.

cards.title: Book a guided gallery tour
cards.subtitle: Patricia & Phillip Frost Art Museum, MMC
cards.notes: Coordinate a group visit, submit the tour request at least three weeks ahead, and ask for an experience suited to your group’s interests.
cards.short_summary: A museum-led tour of current exhibitions and the Sculpture Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Frost Art Museum offers guided tours for FIU students and groups, non-FIU university groups, schools, and community organizations.
cards.source_title: Tours | Patricia & Phillip Frost Art Museum
cards.access_notes: Submit a request at least three weeks in advance. The museum states admission is always free; confirm group-tour availability when requesting.

cards.title: Take a self-guided museum tour
cards.subtitle: Patricia & Phillip Frost Art Museum, MMC
cards.notes: Pick an exhibition route together, move slowly through the galleries, and use the museum’s digital audio-tour content to compare observations afterward.
cards.short_summary: A flexible, independent way to explore Frost exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: Frost Art Museum invites visitors to experience a self-guided in-person audio tour through its museum app.
cards.source_title: Tours | Patricia & Phillip Frost Art Museum
cards.access_notes: Visit during normal museum hours. Frost states admission is always free and open to the public; use of the self-guided experience requires no purchase.

cards.title: Join FIU Museums Insiders
cards.subtitle: Patricia & Phillip Frost Art Museum, MMC
cards.notes: If you are currently enrolled, sign up for the student community, then use its museum connection as a reason to return with classmates.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost FIU student community for museum engagement.
cards.evidence_claim: Frost Art Museum states that currently enrolled FIU undergraduate and graduate students can join its FIU Museums Insiders program and that participation is 100% free.
cards.source_title: Patricia & Phillip Frost Art Museum FIU
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled FIU undergraduate and graduate students. The museum states participation in the program is 100% free.

cards.entity_name: iWitness Lunch Break: Finding Sanctuary in the Diaspora
cards.title: Attend the iWitness Lunch Break
cards.subtitle: SIPA II Room 102, MMC • Aug. 28, 2026
cards.notes: Register for the discussion, arrive with time to settle in, and stay afterward to talk through the ideas with friends or classmates.
cards.short_summary: A public humanities program centered on diaspora, visual storytelling, and dialogue.
cards.evidence_claim: FIU lists this August 28, 2026 iWitness Lunch Break program as free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: iWitness Lunch Break Fall 2026: Finding Sanctuary in the Diaspora | FIU Calendar
cards.access_notes: Friday, August 28, 2026, noon–2 p.m.; registration is listed by FIU. The event is free and open to the public.
